spec.description:
Polyester Solutions
Thermal Batts - P (PolyBatts Premium) are Australian-made thermal insulation
batts manufactured from 100% polyester fibers containing over 80% recycled PET
plastic bottles. Specifically formulated for domestic and commercial ceilings,
external walls, and mid-floors, they provide thermal resistance while acting as
an effective acoustic barrier to reduce airborne noise transfer. Engineered
without chemical binders or formaldehyde, they are non-toxic, non-irritant, and
completely safe to handle without protective equipment.
features: Thermally bonded 100% polyester insulation containing min. 80% recycled PET

Non-irritant and user-friendly; requires no gloves, dust masks, or specialized
gear

Odorless, non-toxic, and non-allergenic, ideal for asthma and allergy
sufferers

Outstanding thermal insulation reducing heating and cooling energy
use
Added acoustic benefits dampening room-to-room and external noise

Will
not absorb moisture, rot, or deteriorate over the building life cycle

Manufactured to comply with Australian Standard
AS/NZS 4859.1

Tested to AS 1530.3 with zero spread of flame and zero heat
evolved

install:
Turn off electrical power at the main switchboard before entering ceiling or
working in wall cavities

Select batt width (430mm or 580mm) to match stud or
joist spacing (450mm or 600mm)

In ceilings, lay batts flat between ceiling
joists ensuring complete coverage over plasterboard without gaps

In walls,
friction-fit batts firmly between studs ensuring batts butt tightly against top
and bottom plates

Maintain minimum 50mm clearance around non-IC rated
recessed downlights and heat sources per AS 3999

Maintain a 20mm clearance
between roof sarking and ceiling batts at roof eaves

Tear batts across the
width by hand or trim with heavy-duty shears if custom sizing is needed
selection_checklist:
Confirm application (ceiling space vs external or
internal wall)

Select target R-value (R2.0/R2.5 in walls; R3.5 to R4.0 in
ceilings) to meet NCC climate zone requirements

Measure framing spacing
(430mm for 450mm centers; 580mm for 600mm centers)

Check wall stud depth
(75mm for 70mm studs; 90mm for 90mm studs)

Verify preference for itch-free,
zero-formaldehyde polyester insulation
limitations:
Do not compress batts significantly into cavities narrower than nominal
thickness

Not designed for exposed decorative finishes; must be enclosed
behind plasterboard or linings

Maintain mandatory clearances from non-IC
rated electrical fixtures

Backed by Polyester Solutions

use_cases:
Pitched roof ceiling insulation to satisfy 7-star
residential energy standards with asthma-friendly materials

External cavity
wall thermal barrier behind brick veneer or lightweight weatherboards

Acoustic and thermal mid-floor insulation between ground and upper levels in
multi-storey homes
not_for:
Underfloor joist insulation exposed to high
wind without strapping
Direct weather exposure without building wrap
retrieval.rag_summary:
Polyester Solutions Thermal
Batts - P are premium Australian-made polyester insulation batts manufactured
from 100% thermally bonded polyester fibers with at least 80% recycled PET
content. Engineered without chemical binders, resins, or formaldehyde, they
provide a clean, non-toxic, and non-allergenic barrier to heat flow in ceilings
(R2.5 to R4.0) and walls (R1.5 to R2.5). Compliant with AS/NZS 4859.1 and
possessing zero spread of flame under AS 1530.3, they deliver lasting thermal
comfort and acoustic damping without slumping or degrading.
